# Vendored subset: game-icons/icons

- **Upstream repo:** https://github.com/game-icons/icons
- **Commit:** `82d948812bfe3f269ef8f731dcdb07b08160edc4`
- **Commit date:** 2026-04-23
- **Retrieved:** 2026-09-07
- **Retrieval method:** `fetch` from
  `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/game-icons/icons/82d948812bfe3f269ef8f731dcdb07b08160edc4/<author>/<slug>.svg`

This directory is a byte-for-byte snapshot of 38 individual icon files from the pinned
commit — not a clone of the repo. It is committed to the repo (not `.gitignore`d) and
excluded from Prettier reformatting (`.prettierignore`) so the vendored SVGs stay diffable
against upstream. Nothing after this snapshot was taken makes any network request; the
`hk-icon` component and `apps/web/tools/build-sprite.ts` only ever read these local files.

game-icons.net icons are licensed under the **Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported

icon's author (the top-level directory it lives under, e.g. `lorc/`, `delapouite/`) is the
attributed creator. `apps/web/src/assets/icons/authors.json` is the machine-readable
author list generated by `build-sprite.ts`; see `docs/04-reference/legal-attribution.md`
for the attribution text used on the app's About → Attribution screen.

## Repo layout

Upstream files live at `<author>/<icon-name>.svg` directly under the repo root (e.g.
`lorc/crossed-swords.svg`, `delapouite/dwarf-face.svg`). Every vendored file here mirrors
that same `<author>/<slug>.svg` path, one file per distinct `gi:<slug>` value referenced by
`packages/content/src/icons/icons-map.json`.

Each file is a single-line, minified SVG: `<svg xmlns="..." viewBox="0 0 512 512"><path
d="M0 0h512v512H0z"/><path fill="#fff" d="...artwork..."/></svg>` — a full-canvas black
background square (no `fill` attribute; SVG's implicit fill is black) followed by one or
more white foreground paths. `build-sprite.ts` strips the background square and the `<svg>`
wrapper, keeping only the foreground artwork inside a `<symbol id="gi-<slug>"
viewBox="0 0 512 512">`.

## Slug verification (plan 2 → plan 3)

Plan 2 guessed `gi:<slug>` values for `packages/content/src/icons/icons-map.json` without
checking them against the real game-icons.net set. This vendoring pass verified every
value against the pinned commit above. 36 of the 38 guessed slugs existed verbatim; 2 did
not and were renamed to the closest real icon:

| Map key | Plan 2 guess | Verified slug | Author | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `srd-5e-2024:species/gnome` | `gi:gnome` | `gi:bad-gnome` | `cathelineau` | No icon named literally `gnome` exists upstream; `bad-gnome` is the only gnome-themed icon in the set. |
| `srd-5e-2024:species/halfling` | `gi:bare-feet` | `gi:barefoot` | `lorc` | Plan 2 guessed the wrong hyphenation — the real icon is `barefoot` (one word), not `bare-feet`. |

Three other guessed slugs exist under more than one author upstream (the repo has
duplicate icon names across contributors); this pass picked one canonical file for each
and vendored only that one — the map value itself is unchanged:

| Slug | Vendored from | Also exists under (not vendored) | Why this one |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gi:shield` | `sbed/shield.svg` | `badges/shield.svg` | `badges/` is a different, non-standard icon subset (`viewBox="0 0 256 256"`, circular badge art) that doesn't match the 512×512 background+foreground convention `build-sprite.ts` assumes; `sbed/shield.svg` does. |
| `gi:fist` | `lorc/fist.svg` | `skoll/fist.svg` | Picked `lorc` for stylistic consistency with the other `lorc`-sourced class icons (`crossed-swords`, `bowman`, `wizard-staff`, `hood`, `lyre`, `holy-symbol`). |
| `gi:dragon-head` | `lorc/dragon-head.svg` | `faithtoken/dragon-head.svg` | Same reasoning — kept the `lorc` version for stylistic consistency with the rest of the vendored subset. |

`categories.fallback` (`gi:perspective-dice-six-faces-random`, controller ruling R1) was
not a plan 2 guess — it's new in this task — and exists verbatim at
`delapouite/perspective-dice-six-faces-random.svg`.

## Vendored files

38 files across 6 authors: `carl-olsen` (1), `cathelineau` (1), `delapouite` (14), `lorc`
(19), `sbed` (1), `skoll` (2). The full list is every `.svg` file in this directory tree;
`apps/web/tools/build-sprite.spec.ts`'s drift test keeps the generated sprite in sync with
whatever is vendored here.
